name: Sopa de Fideo
summary: Thin noodles toasted golden, then simmered in tomato broth with pinto beans. Mexican comfort soup.

ingredients.name: thin spaghetti or vermicelli, broken into 3 cm pieces
cheddar, crumbled or shredded, for serving

instructions: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the broken noodles and stir constantly 3–4 minutes until golden brown. Watch them, because they burn fast.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth, 500 mL water, beans, cumin, and oregano. Bring to a boil.
Simmer 8–10 minutes until the noodles are soft. Season with salt.
Serve topped with cheese and a squeeze of lime.

substitutions.substitute: rice vermicelli, toasted the same way

glutenFree.notes: Beans, tomatoes, and cheese are naturally gluten-free. Check the broth label.

budgetNotes: Toasting the noodles in oil is the step that makes this taste like fideo and not tomato pasta soup. Don't skip it.
Use vegetable broth and leave out the cheese for a vegan version, at about $9.50.
The noodles keep soaking up broth, so add water when reheating.
